name: Supernala Social
description: Supernala Social hosted MCP integration for publishing and scheduling posts, inbox comments, direct messages, analytics, and activity across Social workspaces

tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: Workspaces the person belongs to, their role in each, and pending invitations.

tools.title: List connected accounts
tools.description: Social accounts connected in a workspace, with their IDs, platforms and status.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: List posts
tools.description: Posts made through Social Supernala in a workspace (scheduled and published), newest first, with each account's result. Posts published directly in the platform apps aren't here; get_analytics lists every recent post of an account.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: Publish or schedule a post
tools.description: Posts text with up to ten images or videos, in order, to one or more connected accounts now or at schedule_at. Instagram needs at least one image (JPEG) or video. Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and TikTok take several images or one video, not both; Instagram, Threads and Discord can mix them. This publishes publicly.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

media.description: Images and videos in the order they appear. Each url is a public https link: images JPEG or PNG up to 8 MB, videos MP4 up to 100 MB.

image_url.description: One image as a public https URL of a JPEG or PNG up to 8 MB; or use media.

schedule_at.description: ISO 8601 time to publish, at least a minute ahead. Omit to publish now.

tools.title: Cancel a scheduled post
tools.description: Cancels a post that hasn't started sending.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: List inbox comments
tools.description: Comments and replies on the workspace's posts, newest first, after pulling new ones from the platforms.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: Read a comment thread
tools.description: A comment with the comment it answers and the replies under it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: Reply to or moderate a comment
tools.description: reply (publicly, as the account; needs text), hide, unhide, delete (Facebook and Instagram), or mark resolved, ignored or pending.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: Get account analytics
tools.description: An account's metrics for the last 7 or 30 days compared with the period before, plus metrics for every post the account published in that period, including posts made outside Social Supernala.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: List direct messages
tools.description: Instagram and Facebook Page direct message conversations, newest first.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: Read a conversation
tools.description: The latest messages of one direct message conversation, oldest first.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: Reply to a direct message
tools.description: Sends a direct message reply as the account. Meta allows this only within 24 hours of the person's last message.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

tools.title: List activity
tools.description: Recent actions taken on the workspace's accounts, with who did them and the result.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit for the person's personal workspace.

verificationNotes: First-party provider. The catalog is the complete static tools/list of the Social Supernala MCP server (server 1.1.0, protocol 2025-06-18, one page, 13 tools), taken verbatim from apps/api/src/social-mcp-server.ts (byfungsi/supernala#1077, #1095, #1096) on 2026-11-21. All tools are admitted (9 read, 2 write, 2 destructive), including the comment, direct message and analytics tools behind the social-inbox flag, which return a "not enabled yet" error when it is off. Classifications follow the readOnlyHint/destructiveHint annotations; every write and destructive tool requires approval. Every input schema sets additionalProperties: false, so unknown arguments such as a camelCase workspaceId are refused before dispatch; the server refuses them by name too. list_posts covers only posts made through Social Supernala and points to get_analytics, whose per-post metrics include posts made outside it. publish_post takes up to ten media items (JPEG or PNG images up to 8 MB, MP4 videos up to 100 MB streamed into Social's part upload) or one image_url. Live metadata documents Streamable HTTP, dynamic client registration, PKCE S256 only, the single social scope, authorization-code and refresh grants, and RFC 7009 revocation that ends the grant; no authorization-response issuer parameter. Tokens carry scope "social", a 3,600-second access lifetime and a rotated 30-day refresh token; replaying a rotated-out refresh token revokes the grant. Supernala and Supernala Social stay separate: the Owner approves on the Social consent page, the grant acts as that person in their Social workspaces with membership and viewer rules applied, and the account stays an opaque connection. Live Store consent and production acceptance remain pending.
